properties.name: unit
properties.description: Text after the formatted value. Pass the singular form when the value is one.

properties.name: src
properties.description: Image rendered in place of the tone wash.

properties.name: alt
properties.description: Image description. Defaults to empty because the title already names the folder.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Custom cover content, layered above the image or tone wash.

properties.name: tone
properties.description: Chart palette color, `--chart-1` to `--chart-5`, used by the default cover wash.

properties.name: href
properties.description: Renders the card as a link.

properties.name: level
properties.description: Heading level in the surrounding document.
